mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls exceeding 200,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions that immediately drive positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS > 200,000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through joint demand-supply effects.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and INDPRO both above 12-month moving averages fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annual inflation < 1.5%) prevent premature monetary tightening, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual inflation < 1.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: The presence of a positive federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0) indicates active monetary policy that supports economic stability and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 12-month moving average (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal monetary tightening combined with labor market weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days through joint labor-monetary effects.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and rising FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).
